What Intelligence Owes Marines in the Fight

Episode Notes:
Retired Marine Lieutenant General Mike Groen joins Gary to discuss intelligence support for Marines. He recalls how analysis of an unfinished highway persuaded General Jim Mattis to alter the 1st Marine Division’s maneuver plan during the 2003 Iraq invasion. Groen traces the trust behind that decision through his work preparing 3d Radio Battalion for missions in the Philippines and advancing Vince Stewart’s vision for Marine intelligence. Drawing on his leadership of the Joint Artificial Intelligence Center, he discusses guiding new technology with human judgment and values. He concludes with advice on building professional relationships and pursuing meaningful work beyond the expected career path.
